suggested_claim_revision: In six fresh seed-42, 50-epoch controls of the fixed public-CLIP current recipe, switching the shared training feature delivered to BN/CE and margin-0.3 Triplet from L2-normalized to raw produced mixed results while deployment remained L2-normalized. At each arm's official-mAP-selected checkpoint, raw minus normalized changed mAP/Rank-1 by -2.892652/-1.555026 pp on RGBNT201, -2.391355/+0.233233 pp on RGBNT100, and +1.220876/+3.045684 pp on MSVR310. Only MSVR310 passed its preregistered local progress gate. This is dataset-specific, post-selection development evidence for the joint training-feature boundary, not a general raw-feature advantage, Triplet-only mechanism, full F1 explanation, seed-stable improvement, module contribution or SOTA result.
